ideal: Customers never hit a bug: reviews and failed runs find bugs first, each goes into an issue, and each is fixed fast and stays fixed.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: Security and Privacy Controls

quality: No open critical or high bug, nothing reopened, every failed run in an issue, and every fix with a test.
speed: Bugs found within two weeks of landing, high ones fixed within a day, and every error in an issue within a day.
consumption: No runner minutes lost to failed runs on main in 90 days.
